family.triumph-adler-alphatronic-p.descr: The modular office microcomputers that introduced the Alphatronic P range.
family.triumph-adler-alphatronic-p.histo: Triumph-Adler and Diehl Datensysteme presented the P family at Systems 1979 in Munich. It grew out of the SKS KISS and offered two initial configurations for professional use. The range continued with the P3 and P4 in 1982.
